cues: Stanza eight: the mad time spools, winding up everything onto its reel, and everything is slightly wrong.
Birds on bizarre journeys over the warming earth.
And rhododendron, laligurans, Nepal's national flower, blooming in winter instead of spring: a symptom, not a pretty picture.
Subedi puts environmental collapse beside political violence as one disorder.
All in unison created this soft gale.
And the ending shrinks the public storm to something private: my soft storm dances in ripples of your uneasy lake.
